recorded: Live, grok 1.0.13 (devbox:v5 test session) over `grok agent --always-approve stdio` with the owner's grok-home login, 2026-11-19: a new session (no devbox MCP server), one turn with a shell tool call, the process killed, then session/resume and a second turn. Scrubbed: session, prompt and tool call ids replaced, agent/instance ids and hostname removed, the probe cwd set to /workspace, configured MCP servers and MCP tool lists emptied (MCP tools also dropped from the session's tool list), command lists shortened to their names, response signatures and the subscription tier replaced; stderr (OpenTelemetry export errors) left out.

tips: Use @ to attach files like @src/main.rs.
Use @! for hidden or ignored files: @!.github/workflows.
Press Ctrl+O to toggle auto-approve mode.
Use Shift+Tab to cycle between modes like Plan mode.
Run /compact [context] when chat gets long.
Press Ctrl+B to background a running terminal command.
Start Grok in a fresh worktree with `-w`; add `-r <session-id>` to resume an existing session there.
Use Ctrl+Enter to interject messages. Or just Enter to queue messages.
Run /dashboard (or Ctrl+\) to see and manage all your agents in one place.
Try out workflows using /workflows.
